correctness.rationale: The standalone Python standard-library program enumerates every one of 8192 subsets by two independent definitions; confirms f=(13,78,143,78), 78 tetrahedral facets and purity; eliminates all 66 generators of the fundamental group by 33 initial basepoint-triangle relations plus ordered triangular eliminations; constructs the 143x78 integral third boundary and diagonally reduces it by explicit integral unimodular operations to 76 unit factors and two zero columns; checks d2*d3=0. The rank-66 second boundary follows from simple connectivity and the complete one-skeleton. A simply connected two-skeleton is a wedge of 77 two-spheres; integral Smith reduction of attaching degrees cancels 76 pairs and leaves S2 wedge two S3. Direct SymPy Smith computation of the same signed matrix agreed independently, but is not required for replay. No unverified infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The Paley order-13 graph is a canonical self-complementary, 6-regular strongly regular conference graph, not an arbitrary selected graph. Its two-independence complex is pure of dimension 3 but carries both degree-2 and degree-3 integral sphere summands, giving a concrete natural pure complex that cannot be shellable or Cohen–Macaulay over any field. This is a full integral homotopy classification, not a routine rank restatement, and it delineates a natural nonchordal boundary beyond the inspected cycle/chordal higher-independence families. No family-sized contribution or unrelated downstream theorem is claimed.
